integrity.critical_source_input: The 2026 source supplies the eigenvalue-graded Jordan multiplicity formula J_{k,lambda}, the definition m_c=d-dim(c), the zero-cone identity l^*=1, and subdivision-independent weak-Fano scope.
integrity.proof_status: The maximal block follows by solving m_c-2j+1=d+1 inside the published formula; this forces the unique zero cone and j=0, whose multiplicity and age are both fixed. No finite experiment is used.

scientific_limitations: Only the extremal Jordan layer is determined; lower Jordan-block multiplicities and extension data are not classified.

The same maximal-block conclusion is already a formal consequence of the 2024 sectorwise comparison in its narrower simplicial, vertex-supported family; the new statement is the extension to the full weak-Fano Laurent generality supplied in 2026.

The comparison with older affine polynomial-map monodromy formulas is based on their stated hypotheses and inspected Jordan-block theorems; no claim is made that all possible unpublished reformulations have been excluded.
title: A unique maximal monodromy block in the nonsimplicial weak-Fano Laurent setting
